conjecture: C-A: strict losers in a bumped coalition S form exactly the richer suffix of a slack strict payoff boundary of Lmin(v)

verdict.part_a: NOT REFUTED on its stated domain; reduced to two open sub-claims SC1,SC2; open

proved.Prop0: leximin = lex-max of the partial-sum ladder Sigma_1..Sigma_n; leximin optimum over a convex set is unique
proved.Prop1: phi' != phi  =>  d > s_phi(S)   (violation needs the bump to overshoot S's slack)
proved.Prop2: Delta = phi'-phi lies in the tangent cone D of Core(v) at phi, and Delta(S) >= d - s_phi(S) > 0
proved.Cor2a: every violation has a strict loser OUTSIDE S
proved.Prop3: W is a proper subset of S (W = S impossible)
proved.TheoremA: for any T != S with phi'(T) < phi(T): 0 < phi(T)-phi'(T) <= s_phi(T); with T=W this gives s_phi(W)>0 and loss <= s_phi(W); equality iff W is phi'-tight in v'
proved.Prop4: leximin first-order condition on D (the leximin input to Lemma 1 of threshold.tex); poorest non-constant stratum of Delta contains a loser
proved.TheoremB: exact games are superadditive; if v' is exact then v(T) >= v(S)+d+v(T\S) for T strictly containing S; hence d <= g(S)=min_{j not in S}(v(S+j)-v(S)), every outsider has phi_j >= d-s_phi(S) > 0, and s_phi(N\S) >= d-s_phi(S)

reduction.c: min payoff of a loser in S
reduction.H_c: {i : phi_i >= c}, the richer suffix at that level
reduction.SC1: W = H_c intersect S  (losing is upward closed inside S)   -- OPEN
reduction.SC2: H_c is contained in S (no outsider as rich as the poorest loser) -- OPEN; this is exactly what exactness of v' buys
reduction.equivalence: C-A(a) <=> SC1 and SC2; slackness of H_c is then automatic from Theorem A
